name: Human hue perception
summary: Hue is a perceptual attribute of human color vision related to wavelength and cone/opponent processing, but it is not itself a physical wavelength or oscillation and is not determined by a one-to-one wavelength lookup.

axis.notes: Hue is a perceptual attribute related to spectral input but is not a physical frequency coordinate of an internal oscillator.

constraints: hue depends on cone signals and post-receptoral processing
context, luminance, adaptation, and mixtures can alter perceived color
non-spectral colors and metameric matches rule out a one-to-one wavelength-to-hue identity

evidence.locator: Color Specification, Color Discrimination Functions, and Stage Theory
evidence.derivation: Webvision treats hue as a perceptual color attribute related to wavelength while also describing trichromatic matching, opponent processing, mixtures, and contextual dependencies. Atlas therefore does not assign hue a physical carrier-frequency profile.
